robot: Sharpa Wave dexterous hand (22 finger joints) on a locked six-axis wrist stage: fingers only

frame.base_text: the scene's world frame (+Z up; the wrist stage is fixed in it): the coordinates of the task text

right_hand.note: Sharpa Wave finger joint targets (rad, 22, in the spec layout order: thumb CMC_FE, CMC_AA, MCP_FE, MCP_AA, IP; index, middle, ring MCP_FE, MCP_AA, PIP, DIP; pinky CMC, MCP_FE, MCP_AA, PIP, DIP); no scalar gripper: grasp by closing the fingers on the object

resets.note: 20 resets in all (describe_robot resets.budget). Only the last episode is graded, and a success ends the run.

notes: Fixed-wrist task: the six wrist-stage targets (the first six action columns) must stay at [-0.08, 0, 0.29, 0, 0, 0]; move_robot and execute_trajectory joint rows keep them, and native rows must carry them unchanged. Only the fingers (part right_hand) move. inhand_top and inhand_side are close-ups of the held object (no object state is published). Every column is a position target (servo); grasping and carrying work only through contact. The parts follow the Sharpa Wave layout (describe_robot spec_file: hand "sharpa"). With the Wuji hand (hand "wuji", 20 finger joints per hand) the columns differ: use execute_trajectory space native with the order in spec action_types.joint_position.layout. Rows are 0.02 s apart or a multiple of it; a call covers at most 10 s. Measured poses are in the world frame of the task text, quaternions wxyz.
